app.title: Rubik Rings
cube.hint: Drag the background to orbit · drag a sticker to turn its layer
cube.noWebgl: WebGL is off in this browser, so the 3D cube can't be drawn. The ring diagram below still plays fully.
keys.hint: Letter keys turn · Shift + key: counter-clockwise · Ctrl+Z: undo
rings.title: 9-ring diagram (circle puzzle)
rings.aria: Nine intersecting rings; each dot is one sticker
tabs.label: Tools
solve.hint: Pick a color, then click cells. Tip: copy the current cube, then fix it to match your real one.
solve.failed: The solver failed. Press Solve to try again.
solve.stale: The cube was turned by hand, so this solution no longer applies. Press Solve again.
err.centers: Two faces share the same center color.
err.piece: Some piece can't exist on a real cube (opposite colors side by side, or a wrong color set).
err.twist: A corner is twisted in place: this cube can't be solved.
err.flip: An edge is flipped: this cube can't be solved.
err.parity: Two pieces are swapped: this cube can't be solved.
puzzle.trainingHint: Training puzzles keep the finished part; the top (white) layer is the last layer.
puzzle.failed: Couldn't make a puzzle. Press New puzzle to try again.
puzzle.empty: Pick a level and press New puzzle. The clock starts at your first move.
puzzle.randomState: Random state, like a WCA scramble
puzzle.abandoned: Another tool replaced the cube. Make a new puzzle to time again.
lbl.cross.hint: Turn white to the bottom and place the 4 white edges so their side colors match the centers.
lbl.corners.hint: Bring each white corner above its slot, then repeat R U R' U' until it drops in.
lbl.middle.hint: Match the edge with the front center, then insert it right (U R U' R' U' F' U F) or left.
lbl.topCross.hint: F R U R' U' F' turns a dot into an L, an L into a line, and a line into the cross.
lbl.topEdges.hint: R U R' U R U2 R' U swaps edges until all 4 match their centers.
lbl.cornerPlace.hint: Keep a correctly placed corner at front-right and use U R U' L' U R' U' L.
lbl.cornerTwist.hint: Repeat R' D' R D on each corner until yellow faces up, then turn U to the next corner.
algo.pick: Pick a section to read. The code is cut straight from the 5 reference implementations, so it is the code that really runs.
algo.downloadHint: Each file reads cubes from stdin (one line of 54 digits in U R F D L B order) and prints the Kociemba;LBL solutions. All 5 match the TypeScript solvers move for move (npm run verify:ref).
